title.rendered: WORD4TODAY: The Lord will overwhelm you with mercy

excerpt.rendered: ? Luke 1:58 MSG Her neighbors and relatives, seeing that God had overwhelmed her with mercy, celebrated with her. ? Whenever God overwhelms one with mercy, goodness, favour…

content.rendered:
?

Luke 1:58 MSG
Her neighbors and relatives, seeing that God had overwhelmed her with mercy, celebrated with her.
?
Whenever God overwhelms one with mercy, goodness, favour or blessings, it is not something that can be contained or hidden.

??The beneficiary is usually dazed, surprised? and finds things positively shocking.

??When God overwhelmed Elizabeth with mercy, it wasn’t something she could hide even if she wanted to.

When God overwhelmed David with victories, he was known to have danced?? & leapt for joy not minding his “exalted position ” as a king… He could not contain himself.

God’s mercy is so “pregnantl that if it comes over anyone, anything could happen.

His mercies never walk alone. It comes with favour, blessings, joy, gladness, breakthrough etc.

??The neighbors & relatives of Elizabeth saw it & came to rejoice with her… Hence, God once again showed people what He could do through anyone. ( Psalms 77:14 MSG – You’re the God who makes things happen; you showed everyone what you can do -)

Pray ??
Father, through me, show the world what more you can do in Jesus name.
